tonight.headline: Tuten is out — Gordon to RB, Diggs to FLEX
body: Bad news first. Jacksonville ruled Bhayshul Tuten out for Sunday on Friday afternoon (jaguars.com; NBC 27 Nov 20:56Z) after he missed every practice. He is still sitting in your RB slot, and ESPN still shows his 18.7 — that number is not real. Warren has 4.4 with Pittsburgh-Denver under way, and you trail Footballers 7.9 to 61.4; ESPN gives you 16%.

One move, before 12:00 Sunday: Ollie Gordon II from FLEX to RB, Stefon Diggs from the bench into FLEX, Tuten to the bench. Isaiah Likely carries no designation on the Giants' final report (Yahoo 27 Nov 21:04Z), so his fallback is retired.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Smith-Njigba (21.7) and Nabers (16.6) on Sunday, Bowers (15.2, questionable) on Sunday night. Footballers already have 25.3 from Caleb Williams and 19.6 from Emmett Johnson banked. Leaving Tuten in place turns a 12.7-point seat into a zero.

case.label: Their soft spot
case.body: Justin Herbert missed Thursday and was not seen at Friday's open practice — still in concussion protocol, questionable (CBS 27 Nov). If DJ Uiagalelei starts, it touches their Omarion Hampton and Cameron Dicker. Bowers is questionable after limited practices (Las Vegas Review-Journal via Fantasy Footballers).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing you control beyond the swap. With it made, ESPN's projection is roughly 104 to 145; the gap is theirs to lose, not yours to close.
